sunoData.title: Lantern Keyways
sunoData.tags: Ambient game soundtrack with slow-evolving pulse, drifting modal pads, sparse hand percussion, and a soft ostinato that feels like cautious forward motion; intro opens with distant tonal shimmer, verse-like sections layer ticking wood clicks and hollow bells, mid-section widens with low drones and reversed swells, and the final section adds warmer chords and a subtle rhythmic lift for discovery. Breathable, polished, wide cinematic mix with gentle sidechain motion, vinyl texture, and crystalline transitions., ambient, enigmatic
